question: Kavadi Aattam is a major folk dance form of which of the following states of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kavadi is a folk dance associated with the Tamil Nadu state of India.
 
• Kavadi Aattam is a ceremonial sacrifice and offering practised by devotees during the worship of Lord Murugan, the Hindu God of War.
 
• It is a central part of the** festival of Thaipusam** and emphasizes debt bondage.
 
• Folk dances in India represent the culture and tradition of the community from where they originated
 
• Folk dances are usually performed during the respective community’s celebration- childbirth, festivals, weddings.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **There are different types of Folk dances in India:**

 
 

 **State of Origin**
 **List of Folk Dances in India**
 
 

 **Goa**
 Tarangamel, Koli, Dekhni, Fugdi, Shigmo, Ghode, Modni, Samayi nrutya, Jagar, Ranmale
 
 

 **Jammu & Kashmir**
 **Rauf**, Hikat, Mandjas, Kud Dandi Nach
 
 

 **Karnataka**
 **Yakshagana,** Huttari, Suggi, Kunitha, Karga
 
 

 **Kerala**
 Ottam Thullal, Kaikottikali
 
 

 **Tamil Nadu**
 Kumi, Kolattam, **Kavadi**
